items.text: Understand why NoSQL was invented and what problem it solves vs SQL
Know all 4 NoSQL types: Key-Value, Document, Wide-Column, Graph
Identify the correct AWS NoSQL service for each type and use case
Understand DynamoDB's data model: Table → Item → Attribute
Explain Simple Primary Key vs Composite Primary Key in DynamoDB
Distinguish GSI (Global Secondary Index) from LSI (Local Secondary Index)
Know DynamoDB capacity modes: On-Demand vs Provisioned (RCU/WCU)
Understand Eventually Consistent vs Strongly Consistent reads and cost difference
Explain how AWS DMS works: replication instance, endpoints, migration task
Know the 3 DMS migration types: Full Load, Full Load + CDC, CDC Only
Distinguish homogeneous vs heterogeneous migration and when SCT is needed
Explain what AWS Lambda is and the serverless computing model
Know Lambda's key limits: 15-minute timeout, 128MB–10GB memory, 1000 concurrency
Launch a T2.medium EC2 instance with correct storage and security group rules
SSH into EC2 and install Node.js, npm, and MySQL Server on Ubuntu
Create a MySQL database and table via the MySQL CLI
Build a Node.js/Express backend with file upload handling using multer
Create a React frontend and submit form data to a backend API
Verify application data is stored correctly in MySQL using SELECT queries
